I will think this through the way I always do — start from what I did last year and adjust a little.

I am 63, alone in the household, and my 4.1 mu is only cotton. I have grown cotton here in Quzhou for 40 years, so I know this land. It is sandy loam, gets hot in summer, and I can pump from my well when I need to.

**Seed.** I will buy Bt cotton seed (抗虫棉) — everyone in our village uses it. Before we had it, bollworm would eat half the bolls. Now I still have to spray, but not as much. I will buy about 1.5 kg of seed, one of the varieties the dealer in town sells that my neighbors had good results with last year.

**Fertilizer.** My land has been farmed a long time, so I need to feed it. Before ploughing I will spread about 50 kg of 15-15-15 compound fertilizer per mu as base fertilizer — that is one bag per mu. Then when cotton starts flowering (around early July), I will top-dress with about 25 kg of urea per mu. That gives me roughly:
- Nitrogen: 7.5 (from compound) + 11.5 (from urea) ≈ 19 kg/mu
- Phosphorus: 7.5 kg/mu
- Potassium: 7.5 kg/mu

I would rather put on a little extra than come up short. A bad cotton year is a disaster when I have no other crop.

**Ploughing.** I will hire the tractor man to plough deep once before planting — cotton needs loose soil for the roots. Rotary tilling is not enough for cotton on my land.

**Irrigation.** I have the well. I will water 4 times: once before planting to wet the seedbed, once at budding (现蕾), once at flowering (开花), once when bolls are filling. If the rain is good in August I may skip one.

**Pesticide.** Even with Bt cotton, aphids (蚜虫) and spider mites (红蜘蛛) and lygus bugs (盲蝽) still come. I will spray about 6 times through the season — early for aphids, then mites in hot weather, then again before bolls open.

**Yield.** Last year I got about 240 kg seed cotton per mu. With decent weather I expect about 250 kg/mu this year.
